title: B-tree incremental-blob cursor marking

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeIncrblobCursor marks both a cursor and its owning Btree so later table mutation can cheaply determine whether incremental-blob cursors require invalidation.

external_source_responsibilities: Cursor/Btree lifetime and later invalidateIncrblobCursors behavior
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete straight-line marking body is assigned; public blob-open dispatch remains open.

inputs: Live B-tree Cursor with owning Btree
outputs: Cursor incremental-blob flag set and owning Btree aggregate flag set
contracts.ownership: Cursor and Btree are borrowed; no allocation or transfer.
contracts.state_and_results: Both flags are idempotently set true; no existing state is cleared.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns B-tree serialization; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No error path for a valid cursor.

representation_differences: Boolean fields replace BTCF_Incrblob and hasIncrblobCur integer/bit flags.

oracle.protocol: Mark an initially ordinary Cursor and observe both the cursor flag and owning Btree aggregate flag.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller lock discipline pending.
assurance.malformed_input: Dangling cursor/tree ownership is outside the source contract.
assurance.continuation: Marked state enables later invalidation scans.

integration.native_call_path: Typed mark owner and unit trace exist; public incremental-blob open dispatch remains pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires blob-open integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect public incremental-blob cursor opening to this owner.

src/core/internal/btree_core.zig cursor flags, Btree aggregate flag, and invalidation owner were reviewed
callers: Incremental blob open after establishing the B-tree cursor
Unit trace invokes the owner directly
assertions_branches_cleanup: The active body has no inventory control-flow blocks
upstream_tests: Upstream incremental-blob open, mutation invalidation, and close tests cover this owner
